attchmntText: Ardee Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Ardee Industries Limited filed a transcript of the earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The call was held on 12th November 2026. For Q2 FY27, revenue was Rs. 325 crores, EBITDA was Rs. 29 crores, and PAT was Rs. 18 crores. Sales volume was 15,656 metric tons. For H1 FY27, revenue was Rs. 664 crores, EBITDA was Rs. 63 crores, and PAT was Rs. 38 crores. Total sales volume was 33,300 metric tons. Borrowings as on 30th September 2026 stood at Rs. 35 crores. Exports contributed approximately 37% of H1 FY27 revenue. The company expanded manufacturing capacity to 1,56,950 metric tons per annum. The brand Ardee Lead 9997 was empanelled with the London Metal Exchange. Domestic procurement increased to 27% to 28%.

Ardee Industries Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026. The report, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited, details the utilization of Initial Public Offer proceeds totaling Rs 3,199.98 million. Net proceeds were Rs 2,862.74 million. Funds were utilized for incremental working capital requirements, repayment of borrowings, general corporate purposes, and issue expenses. The monitoring agency confirmed no deviation from the objects disclosed in the offer document. Proceeds were used towards repayment of a term loan, cash credit facility, government dues, salaries, and wages. Unutilized funds amounted to Rs 677.58 million as of the quarter end. The report was placed before the Audit Committee.

voiceSummary: Ardee Industries Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board on November 12, 2026. For the half year, total income from operations was 6,648.66 million rupees, with net profit after tax at 379.61 million rupees. Earnings per share were 1.20 rupees basic and diluted. Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited issued a notice for a postal ballot to seek member approval for the appointment of Ms. Swati Shivanand Salgaonkar, DIN 03500612, as a Non-Executive Independent Director. Singer India Limited reported unaudited results for the half year ended September 30, 2026, with total income from operations at 33,253 lakhs and net profit after tax at 884 lakhs. Earnings per share were 1.60 rupees basic and diluted. Sabrimala Industries India Limited reported unaudited results for the half year ended September 30, 2026, with total income from operations at 50,329.57 lakhs and net profit after tax at 10,280.54 lakhs. Earnings per share were 10.28 rupees basic and diluted.

attchmntText: Ardee Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Ardee Industries Limited filed an investor presentation for an earnings conference call regarding the second quarter of the financial year 2026-27 ended 30th September 2026. The call is scheduled for 12th November 2026 at 05.30 P.M. The presentation is available on the company website. Chairman and Managing Director Sandeep Aggarwal stated the company is strengthening its position in the organized lead recycling industry. He cited favorable regulatory tailwinds from Battery Waste Management Rules and Reverse Charge Mechanism. The company reported FY26 revenue of INR 11,677 Mn and EBITDA of INR 1,471 Mn. Installed capacity stands at 1,56,950 MTPA. The brand Ardee Lead 9997 is listed on the London Metal Exchange and MCX. The company hedges 100% of lead price exposure through LME-based futures contracts.

attchmntText: Ardee Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ardee Industries Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 3,258.30 million INR, with a profit after tax of 180.58 million INR. Earnings per share stood at 0.57 INR. For the half year, revenue from operations was 6,648.66 million INR, and profit after tax was 379.61 million INR. Earnings per share for the half year were 1.88 INR. The company reported a net cash outflow of 116.71 million INR from operating activities for the half year. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 5,454.04 million INR. The results were subjected to a limited review by Nangia & Co. LLP.
